name: Senate of the Philippines
notes: 24 senators by party, full composition after the May 2025 election (IPU Parline, source: the Senate, 2025-07-29). Not today's affiliations. No supporter in the register sits in it.

name: House of Representatives
notes: 318 seats: 253 district and 65 party-list (20th Congress, from 30 June 2025). Who sits is from the House's own list (congress.gov.ph); the site names the party-list group of a party-list member and no party for a district member, so seats are grouped as district and party-list. Members the site shows as inactive are left out and their seats show as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
